=INSERT INTO iot_sensor_data (
  device_id,
  location,
  category,
  temperature,
  humidity,
  pressure,
  battery_level,
  status,
  alerts_count,
  timestamp,
  received_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.device_id }}',
  '{{ $json.location }}',
  '{{ $json.category }}',
  {{ $json.temperature || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.humidity || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.pressure || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.battery_level || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  {{ $json.alerts.length }},
  '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
  NOW()
)

parameters.content:
## IoT Device Monitoring System

**Features:**
- Real-time MQTT message processing
- Anomaly detection with thresholds
- Multi-level alerting (warning/critical)
- InfluxDB time-series storage
- Automated response actions
- Slack notifications
- PagerDuty incident creation
- PostgreSQL logging

**Supported Metrics:**
- Temperature (-10°C to 50°C)
- Humidity (0% to 100%)
- Pressure (950 to 1050 hPa)
- Battery Level (0% to 100%)
- Signal Strength (RSSI)

**MQTT Topic Format:**
sensors/{category}/{location}/{device_id}/{metric}

**Setup:**
- MQTT Broker configuration
- InfluxDB instance
- Slack workspace
- PagerDuty account
- PostgreSQL database
